description: Reject task dependency cycles and audit remaining Wave 1 relationship tables.
statements: CREATE TRIGGER task_dependency_acyclic BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON operations.task_dependency FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION operations.check_task_dependency_cycle()
CREATE TRIGGER relationship_history AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON operations.task_dependency FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.record_organization_relationship()
CREATE TRIGGER relationship_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON operations.task_dependency FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.reject_organization_truncate()
CREATE TRIGGER relationship_history AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON operations.event_workflow_run FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.record_organization_relationship()
CREATE TRIGGER relationship_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON operations.event_workflow_run FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.reject_organization_truncate()
CREATE TRIGGER relationship_history AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON governance.decision_option FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.record_organization_relationship()
CREATE TRIGGER relationship_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON governance.decision_option FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.reject_organization_truncate()
CREATE TRIGGER relationship_history AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON governance.change_request_test FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.record_organization_relationship()
CREATE TRIGGER relationship_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON governance.change_request_test FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.reject_organization_truncate()
